scope: Progress conservation/order/repair arithmetic plus conditional Cut and Ready premises; Authority Step/Trace covers exclusive scan/normal/exit claims and lost-response preservation
physicalReservation: Model begins after first CONS with earlier physical-capacity and local-lease premise; reservation issuer/caller-side failure placement remains source-open
pendingExit: One admitted managed request before terminal claim; arbitrary native nonlocal escape and postclaim asynchronous delivery are outside model
overflow: Actual source overflow can raise and retry GC with retained proc/args; multiple retry rounds and handlers are not modeled
finiteBounds: four args, zero/one required arg, one old writer/borrower, one packet/round and epochs0/1
